Zara Rutherford: young pilot
Zara Rutherford is currently the youngest female pilot to fly around the world alone. In 2022, when she was 19, Zara completed her 52,000-kilometre flight in a microlight, a type of plane that is small but very fast. 16______ It was one that took her through five continents and 31 countries. Before her amazing achievement, the record was held by Shaesta Waiz. Shaesta, an Afghan-born American, completed her flight at the age of 30.
Zara's parents are both pilots and took her up in planes from an early age. It wasn't long before she began learning to fly and eventually started wondering about doing a round-the-world trip. She knew it wouldn't be easy. 17______ It also costs a lot and can be dangerous. When Zara was finishing school, however, she decided the time was right to attempt the journey.
After completing her preparations, she started from Belgium, flying west over countries including the UK and Russia. She then flew to southeast Asia, India and the Middle East, before returning to Belgium. One of the biggest issues was that on a round-the-world flight, conditions change depending on location. 18______ The mild climate in Belgium hadn't provided opportunities to practise in different weather. The freezing temperatures of Alaska and Russia and the sandstorms in the Middle East were huge challenges. 19______ In addition, she sometimes had to get her plane repaired, or collect documents to give her permission to cross certain countries.
Nevertheless, she completed her journey and felt extremely proud of herself. She is keen for other young women to see her achievement, as there are not enough girls and women looking to go into subjects like engineering and technology. There are also very few female pilots. 20______ After all, when people see what she has done, they might be inspired to follow her!

sentences.label: A
sentences.text: Her achievement could help change this in future.

sentences.label: B
sentences.text: This made it perfect for the huge journey she went on.

sentences.label: C
sentences.text: It can therefore change quickly between hot and cold.

sentences.label: D
sentences.text: However, she had done most of her training in Belgium.

sentences.label: E
sentences.text: They helped her prepare well for the trip.

sentences.label: F
sentences.text: These conditions meant she often had to land and wait for longer than planned.

sentences.label: G
sentences.text: In addition, there are other reasons for this too.

sentences.label: H
sentences.text: For one thing, organising everything is very complicated.

explanations.16: Zara 驾驶的超轻型飞机速度快，B 选项 “This made it perfect for the huge journey she went on.”（适合长途飞行）说明飞机优势，与 “52,000-kilometre flight” 衔接。
explanations.17: 环球飞行不易，H 选项 “For one thing, organising everything is very complicated.”（首先筹备复杂）列举挑战，与 “costs a lot and can be dangerous” 并列。
explanations.18: 飞行条件随地点变化，D 选项 “However, she had done most of her training in Belgium.”（但主要在比利时训练）说明准备局限，与 “mild climate hadn't provided opportunities” 呼应。
explanations.19: 极端天气和文件问题，F 选项 “These conditions meant she often had to land and wait for longer than planned.”（需降落等待）说明影响，与 “get her plane repaired, collect documents” 衔接。
explanations.20: 女性飞行员少，A 选项 “Her achievement could help change this in future.”（成就可能改变现状）说明影响，与 “inspired to follow her” 呼应。
